self_report.trigger_items: Related media content,Talking about the event,People who look similar to the victims
self_report.appraisals_items_original: I feel isolated and set apart from others | I can't stop bad things from happening to me | I feel like I don't know myself anymore
self_report.memory_items_original: I remember the frightening event as a few moments, and each moment is a picture in my mind. | My memories of the frightening event are very clear and detailed. | Remembering what happened during the frightening event is just like looking at photographs of it in my mind.
self_report.threat_items_original: Being “superalert” or watchful or on guard? | Feeling jumpy or easily startled? | Having difficulty concentrating?
self_report.strategies_items_original: keep mind occupied all the time | numb emotions | avoid other people
self_report.avoidance_items_original: Seeing people that I socialised with before the event | Watching TV programmes/ films or reading about similar events | Being in circumstances that remind me of the event (eg, being in the dark).
